task: Rank existing static source HTTP handlers, no method/body/edge generation
development: Exactly the previous 32 organization/library development queries and source documents; no new tuning data
test: 40 new RU/EN retrieval queries, split by two new applications; full semantic oracle remains separate and not yet frozen
candidate_pool: Identical complete source handler IDs for every embedding model and common lexical baseline
context_ablation: Not requested in this extension; base text identical for all compared modes
device: mps; CPU fallback is a separately reported runtime if needed
resource_authority: User allowed three local model pilots; no paid/cloud APIs, no target application execution

refusal_calibration.objective: Maximize accepted correct - 2*accepted wrong - 2*false accepts; then fewer errors, more accepted correct, stronger margin

model_selection: Keep CodeRank selected previously by development; do not reselect model/thresholds using these test labels
guardrails: Inference sees corpus/actions/protocol only; no labels, expected graphs, traces or saved predictions in model input
cost: One fresh-process load per model, reused index; three separately reported warm forwards; OS page cache uncontrolled
pre_inference_changes: Replace duplicated no-SMS query family with new document-conversion refusal; define common BM25 monotone score s/(1+s). No model/query forward occurred before this revision.
common_lexical_score: BM25 s/(1+s), only for same 0..1 calibration grid; not a probability
semantics: Retrieval-only extension. It does not complete real graph/state/HTTP/error transfer requirements.
preregistered_comparison: Common Unicode BM25 and previously selected CodeRank; all other models remain separately measured historical pilots
